pricing.details: Personal plans. Interview BootCamp 35 €/month (30-day subscription) — prep for common interview questions, presentation and delivery. Interview Accelerator 90 € for 3 months — LinkedIn profile updates, resume rebuild with AI feedback, interview practice. Interview Pro 271 € once, lifetime access, no expiration — career toolbox for every stage, including offer and salary tools. Official 100% refund if you do not see results within 30 days. Organization and non-profit plans are listed separately and were not recorded here. No lasting 0 € plan was stated — labelled Premium.
